name: Wizard hat
summary: Tall bent pointed wizard hat with a wide brim, stars and a moon; for magic, fantasy and witch scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the brim stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 420 px wide and 700 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.3 on a person's head

params.name: anim
params.note: sway = tip wobbles gently, twinkle = stars blink in turn
